name: semantic_terrain_flux
label: Echoing Labyrinth of Forgotten Meaning
poeticVision: Feel the ground beneath your feet betray you, not by crumbling, but by re-writing its own history. Every step carves a new path through a dreamscape that forgets itself moment by moment. The familiar becomes alien, the safe becomes a trap, as the very architecture of memory shifts its meaning, forcing a desperate intuition to guide you where logic fails. You are racing against not just collapse, but against the world transforming into a foreign, hostile entity that was once intimately yours.
usage: Attach this script to a Node3D in your Godot 4.6.2 scene. The script will automatically generate a procedural terrain mesh and a corresponding navigation mesh upon _ready. Adjust the 'identity_coherence' and 'silence_proximity' export variables in the editor or via code to dynamically change the terrain's structure, introducing more coherent paths or hostile obstacles. Call the 'regenerate_terrain()' method to force a re-generation of the environment and navigation mesh at runtime, for example, when Lyra's identity state changes or the Silence's presence intensifies.

parameters.name: identity_coherence
parameters.description: Controls the coherence of the memory-world. Higher values result in more stable, traversable paths. Lower values introduce more gaps and instability.

parameters.name: silence_proximity
parameters.description: Indicates the closeness of the Silence. Higher values introduce more hostile obstacles and spikes, making traversal difficult.

parameters.name: terrain_size
parameters.description: The number of cells along one axis of the square terrain grid.

parameters.name: cell_size
parameters.description: The size of each grid cell in world units.

parameters.name: height_scale
parameters.description: Maximum vertical displacement for terrain features.

parameters.name: detail_frequency
parameters.description: Frequency for the underlying noise, influencing the overall detail and waviness of the terrain.

verdict: The world itself becomes a treacherous echo of Lyra's fading self, a labyrinth where the ground remembers less than she does.
impact: This mechanic ensures that the very ground Lyra walks on is a constant, dynamic reflection of her internal struggle and external peril. It transforms the environment from a static backdrop into an active antagonist, forcing players into a perpetual state of adaptation and urgency. Every step becomes a gamble, every path a fleeting truth, deepening the sense of self-loss and the relentless pursuit by the Silence.
